newsitem.title: USA: Radio One Inc issues $75 million in 144A debt.
newsitem.headline: Radio One Inc issues $75 million in 144A debt.

text.p: The following 144A debt issue from Radio One Inc was priced on Wednesday, according to a high-yield syndicate source.
Radio One owns and manages African-American radio stations in Baltimore, Philadelphia, and Washington, D.C. Proceeds from the deal will pay for recent acquisitions.
Credit Suisse First Boston Corp and NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc were joint lead managers on the deal.
